messages:
Naveen: Heads-up: Verdigris wants a short POC tomorrow 08:30 PT to validate sustained throughput for an analytics-heavy assistant. Requirements: mixed requests (40% chat, 60% embeddings), target 600 qps sustained for 20m, with three 15s microbursts to 1.2k qps. Need final runbook + quick cost estimate.
Clara: what's the model pin and quantization? Also do they require private deployment or can we run on Dedicated hosted pool?
Naveen: They'll start on Dedicated trial, pin to rdx/embedding+chat-combo-v2 (quant 4-bit where available). Fallback to rdx/embedding+chat-compat if capacity constrained. Cache prefix active, TTL 300s.
Jorge: ops notes: recommend 4 workers (V100x4 equiv) with batching tuned for embeddings vs chat. Autoscale min=3 max=8. Set batching split: 60% embedding-batch-size=128, 40% chat-batch-size=16. Disable multi-tenant preemption for the run.
BenchBot: suggested bench command:
```
rdx-load --scenario mixed --chat-weight 0.4 --embed-weight 0.6 --target 600 --burst 1200:00:00:15 --duration 00:20:00 \
  --model rdx/embedding+chat-combo-v2 --quant 4bit --cache-ttl 300
```
Clara: security asks from their infra team: KMS in us-east-1, need SOC2 attestation copy and encryption-at-rest proof for ephemeral streams. Legal asked to run NDA check; LegalBot, any flags?
LegalBot: NDA on file but needs annex for log retention. SOC2 is standard; provide Statement of Attestation (redacted). No export-control flags.
Naveen: quick cost math for quote: assume avg tokens/response: chat 12 tokens, embeddings billed per vector call flat unit. Approx blended token-equivalent: estimate 5 tokens per request on average -> tokens = 600 qps * 1200s * 5 = 3,600,000 tokens. At blended rate $0.00048/token => $1,728. Embedding add-on estimate (60% of calls) at $0.0002/embed => 0.6*600*1200*0.0002 = $86.4. Ops/monitoring/engineering support + dashboarding/streaming => round to $2.6k total for the run.
Jorge: quick perf note from dry run earlier: p50 chat = 55ms, p95 chat = 210ms, p99 chat = 570ms; embeddings p50 = 12ms, p95 = 45ms, p99 = 110ms. Microbursts produced a 4% 5xx increase when queue depth hit 2s; adjust circuit-breaker to 1.5s and enable soft-rejection.
Clara: fallback behavior: prefer dedicated; if exhausted, route embeddings to hosted-embed-fast variant (lower memory) and chat to rdx/chat-small with circuit-breaker 2s. Document link: https://redwood.ai/docs/routing-policies
Naveen: are there any enterprise blockers? SOC2 copy pending (we can share redacted), HSM procurement timeline 4-6w but not required for POC. They requested IP address allowlist for the run 10.4.1.0/28 - ops, can we add?
Jorge: yes, will add allowlist and open the metrics stream to their dashboard. I'll also add an alert if 5xx > 3% for >1m.
Clara: I'll assemble quote and include itemized costs + runbook + redacted SOC2. Sending to buyer now; will cc ops and legal.
Naveen: thanks. Post-run debrief scheduled 30m after test. Action items: Clara->quote + SOC2 redact, Jorge->allowlist + run dashboard, LegalBot->NDA annex.
BenchBot: run scheduled: 1764309999 08:30 PT. Good luck! :rocket:
